frame_start.description: First frame to render, inclusive. Defaults to 1.

frame_end.description: Last frame to render, inclusive; must be at least frame_start. Defaults to frame_start for a single frame, or 120 frames for a turntable.

frame_step.description: Spacing between rendered frames. Defaults to 1.

engine.description: Render engine. Use the scene's own: "eevee" when scene.render.engine is BLENDER_EEVEE. Defaults to "cycles".

samples.description: Samples per pixel: Cycles samples, or EEVEE render samples. Defaults to 128 for Cycles and 64 for EEVEE.

resolution_pct.description: Percentage of the scene output resolution. Defaults to 100.

camera.description: Name of the scene camera object. If omitted, use the active camera in the bundle.

denoise.description: Denoise rendered frames (Cycles; EEVEE ignores it). Defaults to true.

turntable.description: Render a 360° turntable instead of the scene camera: a generated camera orbits the target objects (or the whole scene) once across frame_start..frame_end, so the frames loop seamlessly. If frame_end is omitted, renders 120 frames. A named camera only lends its lens.

targets.description: Objects to frame and orbit, usually the selection; their children are included. Empty or omitted frames the whole scene.

elevation_deg.description: Camera height as an angle above the targets' centre. Defaults to 20.

margin.description: Framing padding; 1 fits the targets' bounding sphere exactly. Defaults to 1.15.
